capabilities: Render Pandoc-style superscripts, subscripts, fancy lists, and unordered list markers
Render definition lists, example lists with cross-references, and fenced divs with titles
Support custom label lists with references and placeholder numbering
Continue, cycle, and renumber lists while editing
Export notes through the Pandoc CLI with bundled Lua filters and format profiles
extras: Pandoc export is disabled by default, desktop-only, and verified only with Pandoc 3.10.2; full documentation lives on separate linked pages.
problem: Obsidian's Markdown renderer does not support Pandoc's extended list and inline syntax, so notes using it display as plain text.

relations.evidence: Pandoc export is an optional desktop-only module

summary: Renders Pandoc Markdown extensions such as fancy, definition, and example lists, super/subscripts, and fenced divs in preview.
